crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The interface hit an unexpected error. Saved notes are not affected; input from the last few seconds that was not saved yet may need to be retyped. Reload to continue.
crash.details: Technical details (attach when reporting the problem)

failure.MODEL_INSTALL_BLOCKED_RELOCATION: Model storage is being moved; install after it finishes.
failure.MODEL_MISSING: The required model is not installed — install it under Settings › Local models, or switch the default model
failure.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The local inference engine is not ready — check its status on the Local models page
failure.UPSTREAM: The AI engine returned an error. Please retry.
failure.SERVER_SIDE_FAILURE: The server’s compute is unavailable right now (not your network or credential). Retry shortly, or switch to an on-device model.
failure.SERVER_MISCONFIGURED: The server is misconfigured; retrying will not help. Ask your administrator, or switch to an on-device model.
failure.EMPTY_AFTER_THINKING: The model the server picked returned only its reasoning, with no answer. Retrying selects a model again and usually succeeds; if it keeps happening, ask your administrator to adjust the models for this service tier.
failure.INPUT_TOO_LONG: The content is longer than the model can process at once, so retrying as-is won't help. Shorten it and try again.
failure.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: The device does not have enough available resources. Close other model tasks or select a smaller model.
failure.INVALID_INPUT: The server’s compute did not accept this request. If the content is long, shorten it and retry; if it keeps happening, ask your administrator to check the models for this capability.
failure.PERMISSION_DENIED: The required system permission has not been granted.
failure.SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: You are not signed in, or your sign-in expired, so the server did not accept this request. Sign in again on the Account page, then retry.
failure.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No executable provider is assembled for this AI capability. Configure a server or on-device model under Compute and Models, then retry.
failure.COMMAND_FAILED: Lunarca could not start this request. Please retry.
failure.generic: The task could not be completed. Check its requirements and try again.
failure.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: Not enough server quota, so this request never started — nothing was consumed and nothing half-finished was left behind. Check remaining amounts and reset time under Account › Subscription & usage, then retry once you have more, or switch to an on-device model.
failure.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: Your organization has not enabled this capability on the server — retrying will not help. Switch to an on-device model, or ask your administrator if you need the server.
failure.ACCOUNT_FROZEN: Your account is read-only because of a payment dispute, so the server has paused chat, translation and transcription — retrying or upgrading will not help. Your data is not affected; contact support to resolve it, and use on-device models in the meantime.
failure.SPEND_CAP_REACHED: You've reached the monthly prepaid spending cap you set, so this request didn't start and nothing was consumed. Subscription-included quota isn't affected by the cap. Adjust the cap under Account › Subscription & usage, or switch to an on-device model in the meantime.
failure.ALREADY_PROCESSED: The server already accepted this request (still running, or finished with a result that cannot be replayed). This attempt’s output is gone; send a new request instead.
failure.RATE_LIMITED: The service is temporarily rate-limiting requests. Wait for the indicated window and retry.
failure.ROUTE_LANE_EMPTY: The server has no model configured for this service tier — retrying will not help. Ask your administrator to add one on the Routing page; until then, switch to a local model.
failure.LOCAL_SESSION_BUSY: The previous realtime voice session hasn't fully wound down, so this one couldn't start. Wait a few seconds and try again.
failure.SELF_CHECK_TIMEOUT: The test task timed out after 30 seconds. The server may be unreachable, or a local model may still be loading — try again, and if it persists check the readiness shown under “Current execution locations”.
failure.FREE_QUOTA_WITHHELD: This account can't receive free quota right now, so this request didn't start and nothing was consumed. Prepaid credits and paid plans still work; see Account › Subscription & usage for why and what to do, or switch to an on-device model in the meantime.

vaultError.LIST_CURSOR_INVALID: This list position is no longer valid. Refresh and try again: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_ALREADY_EXISTS: A file with that name already exists. Choose a different name: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_ATOMIC_PUBLISH_UNSUPPORTED: This vault location does not support safe writes (no hard-link support, or the directory is not writable). Move the vault to a regular folder on a local disk: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_DECODE: The metadata could not be parsed; the file may be damaged: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_INVALID_CUE: The caption edit is not valid — no matching segment was found: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_INVALID_META_NAME: That metadata name is not valid: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_INVALID_MOVE: The item cannot be moved to that location: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_INVALID_REPLACE: The replace request is ambiguous; the scope could not be determined: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_INVALID_SCOPE: That generation scope is not valid: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_IO: Reading or writing the file failed. Check disk space and file permissions: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_NOT_FOUND: This note could not be found — it may have been moved or deleted: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_NOT_MARKABLE_AS_DRAFT: This kind of content cannot be marked as a draft: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_NOT_UTF8: This file is not UTF-8 text and cannot be read as a note: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_NOT_WRITABLE: Some notes can't be written (read-only or in use), so the rename didn't run and nothing changed: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_CLOUD_PLACEHOLDER: This note is still in iCloud and not downloaded to this Mac. Downloading now; it opens when ready: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_RELOCATION_STALE: These notes were edited or moved after the rename, so it can't be undone: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_RELOCATION_PARTIAL: The rename failed partway and was rolled back as far as possible; these could not be restored, please check them: {{detail}}
vaultError.VAULT_PATH_ESCAPE: That path is outside your vault; the operation was blocked: {{detail}}

saveBlocksMove: A note couldn't be saved (it may conflict with an outside change). Resolve it, then rename or move again.

menu.renameHint: Lunarca keeps the extension, so renaming never changes the file type; links pointing here are updated too.
